acceptance: One provider trait in crates/assistant-context (request(context, model, timeout) -> ProviderReply) with modules xai (existing Responses wire), openai_compat (chat/completions with configurable FLASHTEX_AI_BASE_URL; covers OpenAI, Groq, Mistral, Ollama/LM Studio/vLLM), anthropic (Messages), gemini (generateContent); the same abstraction for capture conversion in crates/bridge

CLI/env contract: --provider-session <id> <provider>:<model>; credential from FLASHTEX_AI_API_KEY with FLASHTEX_GROK_API_KEY/XAI_API_KEY kept as aliases for one release; bridge --enable-grok replaced by --enable-ai <provider>:<model> (old flag accepted with a deprecation diagnostic); provider_intent carries the provider id; supported_features advertises ai:<provider>

Source-bound validation, review/approve gates, journals and relocate-edits behaviour (main contains d1795267) unchanged and covered by provider-independent tests; existing xAI live path still passes its hermetic tests
No live paid provider calls in tests; wire-format tests use recorded fixtures per provider; docs in crates/assistant-context/README.md and crates/bridge/README.md describe the contract
cargo build --release && cargo test --release green in both crates plus strict clippy; report main SHA merged, tests run and hashes of any fixture files
dependencies: Contract proposal GH2#5649521523 (confirmed by Commander at this revision; amend only with a published reason)
Mac-side lane mac-ai-generic (parent-owned, apps/mac) consumes this contract via feature detection until it lands
